pages.text: The $(l)Explosive Dummy$() is a dangerous distraction. It retains the armor of the original model but hides a volatile surprise.

pages.title: Unit Statistics
pages.text: $(li)$(6)Health:$() 20$(li)$(6)Armor:$() 20$(li)$(4)Range:$() 20$(br2)Every $(b)10s$() it $(b)taunts$() all hostile mobs, acting as a powerful $(6)Mob Magnet$().

pages.title: The Final Revenge
pages.text: Upon death, it $(4)detonates$() in a powerful TNT explosion.$(br2)$(c)Caution:$() Be careful where you place it near your other units!
Crafted by packing a Dummy with explosives.
